answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through periodic token destruction on an escalating schedule. To participate, each node must verifiably burn liquid capital at the dawn of every epoch, triggering an unrecoverable expense spiral that makes operating a vast dune of synthetic entities financially ruinous. Attackers incur direct, non-refundable capital depletion per identity. However, continuous burning imposes deadweight losses that disproportionately penalize low-budget, honest agents.
